Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Represents PostgreSQL timestamp without time zone, including BC values and infinities.
The default value is 2000-01-01 00:00:00.

```csharp
public readonly struct PgTimestamp : IEquatable<PgTimestamp>
```

Implements: [IEquatable&lt;PgTimestamp&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iequatable-1)

## Constructors

<a id="member-8e96a339bf5439d2"></a>

### PgTimestamp(long)

Creates a timestamp from microseconds relative to 2000-01-01. Int64 extremes represent infinities.

```csharp
public PgTimestamp(long microsecondsSinceEpoch)
```

Parameters:

`microsecondsSinceEpoch` — [long](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int64)

The signed PostgreSQL timestamp offset.

Exceptions:

- [ArgumentOutOfRangeException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentoutofrangeexception): The finite value is outside PostgreSQL's timestamp range.
